Deleted extreme ranks affect only the r=0 string and degree changes affect r=0,1; their exact continuant blocks plus the r>=2 even-eigenvalue strings exhaust 2^n-2 coordinates. The radial path cofactor and rank-two endpoint determinant identity evaluate D_n and the nonzero eigenvalue product, and Kirchhoff yields the displayed tree formula. Fresh independently constructed integer Laplacians for n=3,4,5 have exactly the predicted characteristic polynomials and tree counts 6, 331776, 97955205120000000. The infinite proof uses the symbolic decomposition, not those checks.
